title: Data extraction
promptText:
Extract structured data from the unstructured administrative text below.

Return a Markdown table with columns:
| Field | Value | Source span (short quote) | Confidence (High/Med/Low) |

Extract only what is explicitly present:
- Tender / work name
- NIT or file reference (if any)
- Dates (publish, bid submission, opening)
- Estimated value / EMD (if stated)
- Location / circle / division
- Eligibility highlights
- Contact office (if stated)

Rules:
- Never invent missing numbers or dates.
- If a field is absent, write "Not stated".
- If two values conflict, list both and mark Low confidence.
- After the table, list "Ambiguities" as bullets.
- Do not provide legal interpretation — extraction only.

UNSTRUCTURED TEXT:
[Paste notice / email / scanned OCR text]
